observations.behavior: Adds new lookup endpoints (call_results, pipelines, custom_fields, deal_fields) to the OnePageCRM source configuration and explicitly marks them as unpaginated full-refresh lookups.
observations.posthog_connection: These are metadata/lookup tables required by warehouse ingestion; their absence would prevent PostHog from correctly interpreting CRM data. Adding them expands supported entity types without changing core event processing.

observations.behavior: Changes tests to use endpoint-specific primary keys instead of assuming 'id', while also adding pagination and sorting assertions for the new lookup endpoints.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection against incorrect key assumptions and validates page-walking and optional sort parameters for the expanded set of entities.
